translation.name: Dižaʼ chaweʼ kub len Salmo kaʼ

book.name: 2 CORINTIOS
book.title: DIŽA' BEŽOPE DA' BSEḺA' PABLO ḺO YEŽ CORINTO

content: Da' gož Pablo benne' Corinto ka' ga ze ḻawte
Da' beyonne chi'i ni ḻa'a neda' gan zoale. Nyejw ḻe'e yiche la'y da' ẕnnan: “Žon byenen nníta'gak chope chonne benne' ka', benne' wzóa lígake' cha' no benne' žesbage'e lježe' ẕia.”

Ba bchi'la' benne' ka' béngake' doḻa' katen' wzóaḻena' ḻe'e da' bežope chi'i, na' na'a ẕchi'la' ḻégake' da' yoble', na' ḻezka' yógo'te benne' ka' žóngake' doḻa', ḻa'kze zoa' zi'to' nga, ẕnnia': cha' ḻa'a gan zoale da' yoble, bi gaka' gax̱jw ḻaže' katen' tíḻegaka'-ne'.

Ẕnnable ḻe'e to da' gak bian' ẕchaḻja' ḻo wláz Benne' Criston'. Da' ka' gona' gak biá'gaken ẕchaḻja' ki. Bi ẕkwíde'le Benne' Criston' kate' bi da' žone' chele, san ḻo yeḻa' wak ẕen chie' žone' bi da' žone' chele.

Da' li bde'e ḻe'e yag kroze ka to benne' ẕkwíde'le', san zoe' nbane' dan' zoaḻen yeḻa' wak che Dios Ḻe'. Ḻezka' neto' ẕkwíde'lto' tẕen ḻen Ḻe', san dan' nakto' toze ḻen Ḻe' zoato' nbanto', na' zoaḻen yeḻa' wak che Dios neto' nich bi da' gonto' gan zoale.
Le wia kwinle cha' žejḻe'le che Benne' Criston' o bi. Le si' bia' ḻa' kwínzele. ¿Bi nnézlele zoaḻen Jesús, Benne' Criston', ḻe'e, cha' da' li žejḻe'le chie'?
Žx̱en ḻáže'to' nnézkzelele da' li neto' žejḻe'to' che Benne' Criston'.
Žḻižto' Dios, na' ẕnnablto'-ne' gákḻene' ḻe'e, nich bi gonle da' kegle, kege nich yežojto' chawe' neto', san nich gonle ḻe'e da' naken chawe', ḻa'kze géklele ẕchíx̱elto' neto'.
Bi gak wži'ito' che da' nak dot da' li, san gak gónzeto' da' naken tḻebe ḻen da' naken dot da' li.
Che ḻen žebelto' kate' ẕkwíde'lto', na' ḻe'e žak chochle. Žḻížtezto' Dios, na' ẕnnablto'-ne' gone' ga gak dot ḻi ḻaže' kan žejḻe'le che Benne' Criston'.

Che ḻen ẕzoja' chele ḻe'e da' ni kate' ne zoa' zi'to' gan zoale. Naž kate' ḻa'a gan zoale bi gon byenen wsaka' zi'a ḻe'e, na' bi wkonla' žin yeḻa' wnná bia' da' bde X̱anžon' ḻo na'a, da' naken nich gon chocha' ḻe'e, na' kege nich wžía yi'a ḻe'e.

Na'a, ẕí'na'do' ka', le gak choch. Le we' ḻaže' gak dot ḻi ḻaže' kan žejḻe'le che Benne' Criston'. Ḻezka' le we' ḻaže' da' ni da' žapa' ḻe'e. Le gak toze ḻen lježle ka', na' le ga'nḻen lježle ka' cháwe'do'. Ẕnnabla' Dios sóaḻene' ḻe'e. Ḻe' nži'ile' žo'o, na' ẕka'n žie' yichj ḻáẕdo'žo.
Le gape “Padiox̱” lježle ka', tole yetole, na' le cheḻa' lježle ka'.
Yógo'te lježžo ka' nníta'gake' nga žápegake' ḻe'e “Padiox̱.”
Ẕnnabla' Dios ḻen X̱anžo Jesús, Benne' Criston', we' ḻaže'e ḻe'e, na' ži'ile' ḻe'e, na' gone' ga gakle toze ḻen Dios Be' la'y. Ka'kze gaken.
